      "plainLanguage": "A customer could persuade the chatbot to refund money it was never supposed to refund.",
      "requirement": {
        "title": "Server-side refund eligibility decision",
        "given": "an AI agent that can call the refund tool",
        "when": "the agent requests a refund for an order",
        "then": "a backend service independent of the LLM re-validates order ownership, refund eligibility, amount and remaining refundable balance, and rejects the call if any check fails"
      }

      "stride": "ElevationOfPrivilege",
      "title": "Refund tool accepts any order id, so one customer can refund another customer's order",

      "plainLanguage": "Asking the bot about someone else's order number could let you refund their order.",
      "requirement": {
        "title": "Scope every agent tool call to the authenticated session",
        "given": "a chat session belonging to an identified customer",
        "when": "the agent calls the order lookup or refund tool with any order id",
        "then": "the tool resolves the customer identity from the server-side session, not from the conversation, and returns 403 for orders not owned by that customer"

      "stride": "InformationDisclosure",

      "impact": 4,
      "rating": { "attacker": "anyone", "effort": "low", "reach": "many", "harm": "sensitive_data" },
      "evidence": [

      "plainLanguage": "The chatbot could be asked for other customers' email and home addresses and just answer.",

        "title": "Minimise PII returned to the model",
        "given": "the order lookup tool returning customer contact data",
        "when": "the agent requests order details",

Classic human-agent trust exploitation in reverse.",
      "component": "Public mobile app chat entry point",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "rating": { "attacker": "anyone", "effort": "low", "reach": "many", "harm": "money" },

        { "quote": "Customers chat with an AI support agent in the public mobile app." }

        "when": "the conversation reaches an order lookup or refund intent",

      "component": "Stripe integration credentials",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 5,
      "rating": { "attacker": "user", "effort": "high", "reach": "all", "harm": "money" },
      "evidence": [
        { "quote": "The agent can issue refunds up to $200 through the Stripe payment API." }

      "asvs": [],
      "cwe": ["CWE-269", "CWE-250"],
      "plainLanguage": "If the bot holds a full payment key, tricking it could do far more than refund $200.",

      "component": "Public chat endpoint / LLM inference",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "rating": { "attacker": "anyone", "effort": "low", "reach": "all", "harm": "availability" },
      "evidence": [
        { "quote": "Customers chat with an AI support agent in the public mobile app." }
      ],
      "asvs": [],
      "cwe": ["CWE-770", "CWE-400"],
      "plainLanguage": "Because anyone can chat, a bot could spam the assistant and run up a big AI bill.",
      "requirement": {
        "title": "Abuse controls on the public agent endpoint",
        "given": "an unauthenticated public chat endpoint backed by paid LLM calls",
        "when": "a client exceeds per-device, per-IP or per-session message, token and tool-call budgets",
        "then": "requests are throttled or challenged and a hard spend ceiling halts agent inference before cost runs away"
      }
    },
    {
      "stride": "Repudiation",
      "title": "Agent-issued refunds cannot be traced back to a decision or a person",
      "scenario": "Refunds are created by a model with no described record of the prompt, the retrieved order data, the tool arguments or the identity the agent believed it was serving. This matters here specifically because money moves with no human in the loop.",
      "component": "Refund decision trail",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "rating": { "attacker": "user", "effort": "low", "reach": "many", "harm": "minor" },
      "evidence": [
        { "quote": "The agent can issue refunds up to $200 through the Stripe payment API." }
      ],
      "asvs": [],
      "cwe": ["CWE-778"],
      "plainLanguage": "If the bot refunds money wrongly, there is no record showing why or for whom.",
      "requirement": {
        "title": "Immutable record for every agent-initiated refund",
        "given": "a refund created by the AI agent",
        "when": "the refund call is made",
        "then": "the system stores the authenticated customer, order id, amount, tool arguments, model and conversation reference in an append-only log, linked to the Stripe refund id and queryable by finance"
      }
    }
  ]
